mobile.one_time_authorization_for_this_i: One-time authorization for this iPhone: all projects registered on this Mac now and in the future.
mobile.or_grant_access_to_individual_pro: Or grant access to individual projects only.
mobile.if_no_projects_are_selected_your_: If no projects are selected, your phone will pair without access to any projects.
mobile.manage_access_for_phones_you_ve_a: Manage access for phones you've already paired.
mobile.choose_access_for_this_phone_incl: Choose access for this phone, including future projects if needed.
